role: T23B implements the frozen native node contract (tests/bun/fixtures/native-node-contract.json, T23A) as JavaScript facade surface in js/facade/extensions/node.js and freezes the facade shape here: the WHATWG creation names adapted from the native DocumentHandle surface, the Node navigation properties, construction restrictions, descriptor shape, conversion-entry and identity rules

createElement.behavior: adapts native DocumentHandle.createElement; mints a fresh detached Element wrapper through ctx.wrapLazyNode (falling back to ctx.wrap on older bindings); an invalid name throws ERR_MAD_DOM_INVALID_CHARACTER

createTextNode.behavior: adapts native DocumentHandle.createText under the WHATWG name createTextNode (no native symbol of that name); mints a fresh detached Text wrapper through ctx.wrapFreshTextNode (falling back to ctx.wrap on older bindings)

Node.factory: Document.createElement routes through ctx.wrapLazyNode, Document.createTextNode through ctx.wrapFreshTextNode, and mixed-version creation/navigation through ctx.wrap; all routes converge on the document token identity table

nodeType.behavior: WHATWG Node.nodeType (1 Element, 3 Text, 8 Comment, 9 Document, 11 DocumentFragment), delegated to the native NodeHandle

parentNode.behavior: Node wrapper or null; null when the node is detached; result routed through ctx.wrap

firstChild.behavior: Node wrapper or null; null when the node has no children; result routed through ctx.wrap

lastChild.behavior: Node wrapper or null; null when the node has no children; result routed through ctx.wrap

previousSibling.behavior: Node wrapper or null; null at the head of the sibling chain; result routed through ctx.wrap

nextSibling.behavior: Node wrapper or null; null at the tail of the sibling chain; result routed through ctx.wrap

childNodes.behavior: ordered array of wrapped children; an empty array for a leaf node (the live childNodes facade is T25D's)

construction.rule: Node can only be constructed from a genuine native NodeHandle (has nodeType(), nodeName() and childNodes()); every other argument throws TypeError
construction.message: Node can only be constructed from a genuine native Node handle

conversionEntry.ctx.wrap: the canonical native handle -> facade wrapper conversion entry; native results route through it and converge with lazy token wrappers in the per-document identity table
conversionEntry.ctx.wrapLazyNode: the document-scoped token -> facade wrapper conversion entry added by ADR-0007; later native materialization converges on the same facade object
conversionEntry.ctx.wrapFreshTextNode: the creation-only fresh Text specialization of ctx.wrapLazyNode; it skips generic kind dispatch and registers in the same document token identity table

registry.install: node.js exports install(ctx); the facade registry picks it up without any registry change; other capability extensions stay placeholders

identity.rule: while a document is alive, repeated facade reads of the same Core node hand back one and the same JS object (strict equality), via ctx.wrap, ctx.wrapLazyNode and ctx.wrapFreshTextNode converging on the document token identity table
identity.distinct: each createElement / createTextNode call mints a fresh, distinct node

delegation.rule: navigation reads use Core-derived, structural-epoch-validated memos and bounded token snapshots, falling back to the native NodeHandle; the facade keeps no authoritative second DOM state and a Core NodeId never crosses the boundary
